ideas.pitch: An offline-first AI concierge for campus event management and student queries built specifically for Geeta University students.
ideas.title: CampusPulse AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the real-world AI track by solving an immediate localized campus problem, making it highly relatable to on-site judges.

ideas.pitch: A zero-knowledge verifiable attendance system for offline campus events ensuring privacy and tamper-proof records.
ideas.title: ZK-Attendance & Verify
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines decentralized Web3 systems with genuinely hard engineering like cryptographic proofs, standing out in technical depth.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous multi-agent assistant that helps hackathon teams coordinate tasks, check git commits, and manage submission deadlines.
ideas.title: Agentic Hack-Mate
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the trend of AI agents dominating recent hackathons by building an interactive tool tailored directly to the hackathon experience.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized peer-to-peer file sharing and communication tool designed for campus offline environments without reliable internet.
ideas.title: LocalMesh P2P
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses networking constraints during offline hackathons with robust distributed systems engineering.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered local linter and crash analyzer that automatically detects and suggests fixes for runtime bugs in offline codebases.
ideas.title: AutoBug Sentinel
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses the hackathon's call to 'tame chaotic bugs' by providing immediate utility to struggling teams on day two.
